messages:
Nadia: Following up on last night's outage where autoscaler failed to provision GPUs fast enough. I'm consolidating owners + short timelines here so we can close the loop. OpsBot, paste the brief incident summary.
OpsBot: INC-2026-101: symptom: long queue + failed pod scheduling (InsufficientGPU) after 03:10 UTC job burst. Peak queued: ~310 pods. Autoscaler log: 'scale request not honored' x54; API rate limit retries observed. Impact ~03:08-03:55 UTC.
Rafael: Observed a repeated pattern: large eval batches run at 03:00 UTC from multiple teams (eval, benchmarks). This is the 4th time in 8 weeks. Root causes coalescing: (A) aggressive cron scheduling, (B) autoscaler backoff & rate limiting, (C) tight node pool headroom.
Tao: Quick mitigation I pushed last week (temporary node pool bump) helped but not sustainable. Proposals: (1) autoscaler client retry smoothing, (2) reserve a small dedicated "spike" pool, (3) enforce per-team concurrency caps for eval jobs.
Wen: I'll own the autoscaler client work. Plan: add exponential jitter + increase rate limit window to avoid 429 storms. Patch PR is TA-1172. Test in staging by Tue. If green, deploy to canary after 48h of healthy runs.
Carmen: I'll handle quota/commit route. Filing CLOUD-5421 now to request a small permanent buffer pool (30 GPUs) for short bursts. Expect initial approval in 4bd, escalate if needed. Adding cost justification and spike graphs.
Victor: Scheduler change idea: enable elastic preemption thresholds and bump kube-scheduler's binding timeout to reduce false timeouts. Tiny config that we can A/B in canary: 
```
scheduler:
  bindTimeoutSeconds: 60
  preemption:
    enabled: true
    threshold: 0.8
```
I'll create the PR and label it for canary-only.
Nadia: Action items summary (short):
- CLOUD-5421  Carmen  quota + buffer pool request  ETA 4bd
- TA-1172  Wen  autoscaler retry/jitter + rate-limit tuning  staging Tue, canary after 48h
- Scheduler PR  Victor & Tao  bind timeout + preempt threshold  canary next week
- Eval job concurrency caps  Rafael  propose per-team limits and cron spread by Mon
- Headroom workbook & runbook update  Nadia  add buffer math + emergency playbook by Thu
Please react with ack or if you need more time.
Rafael: ack, I'll draft the per-team limits and coordinate with benchmarks team. Will include a fallback: job backoff when queued >50.
Wen: ack  PR created: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1938  running unit + integration tests now.
Carmen: CLOUD-5421 created and linked to finance review. Tagging @ops-budget for faster approvals.
Victor: PR for scheduler config is up (infra#1941). Will run synth spike tests on staging cluster later today.
Tao: I'll pair with Victor on preemption test plan and runbook wording. Suggested test: simultaneous 200 small pods spike, verify preemption latency <30s.
Nadia: Good. Also we should add a metric alert for autoscaler 429 rate >5/min so we detect throttling earlier. Wen, can you add that to your PR?
Wen: Will add alert rule to TA-1172. Also adding dashboard panel with retry count vs scale events.
Rafael: FYI I scheduled a short sync with Benchmarks and Eval teams tomorrow 09:00 UTC to coordinate cron changes.
OpsBot: Reminder set: follow-up in 72h for status check on actions.
Nadia: Thanks everyone. If any blocker pops up, post here and we'll escalate to oncall. Closing this thread for tracking; will reopen when the first canary results are in.
